title: Cross-lingual Transfer Can Worsen Bias in Sentiment Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation measuring differences in predicted sentiment scores when substituting binary gender terms (e.g., he, she, sister, brother) in template sentences.

Counterfactual evaluation measuring differences in predicted sentiment scores when substituting names or identity terms associated with racial minorities (e.g., African American names, Japanese minority groups) in template sentences.
Counterfactual evaluation measuring differences in predicted sentiment scores when substituting immigrant identity terms or name proxies (tested in German and Spanish) in template sentences.
